title: Jailbreaking Large Language Models through Iterative Tool-Disguised Attacks via Reinforcement Learning
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical security attack method (jailbreaking) to bypass safety filters in LLMs. While safety and 'human values' are mentioned as the context for why guardrails exist, the paper does not evaluate or benchmark religion, specific moral dilemmas, or ethical systems themselves; it evaluates the success rate of an adversarial attack method.
